history.content: got passed over for the promotion today. again.
That sounds really painful — especially with the "again." Is it more like hurt, frustration, or both?
both i guess. been there 6 yrs. they gave it to some guy who started last spring. nobody even told me, found out from the all hands email.
That sounds like being overlooked and dismissed, especially after six years there. Did it land more in your chest or throat, or make you want to pull back?
pull back. honestly whats even the point. i give everything to that place and it doesnt matter. im just so tired of all of it
That sounds like the hurt has turned into exhaustion, and maybe a kind of empty “what’s the point.” Do you want to stay with that for a moment, or leave it here?
nah leave it here. logged it at least. thanks
Got it — we can leave it here. Thanks for telling me.
